kpis.description_fr: Tonnes containerboard livrées post-merger Smurfit Kappa + WestRock (juillet 2024). Leader mondial corrugated packaging.
kpis.description_en: Containerboard shipments post Smurfit Kappa + WestRock merger (July 2024). Global corrugated packaging leader.

kpis.description_fr: Synergies coûts run-rate annualisées merger Smurfit + WestRock. Cible 400 M$ atteinte fin 2025, possible upside vers 500 M$.
kpis.description_en: Run-rate cost synergies from Smurfit + WestRock merger. $400M target hit end-2025, possible upside to $500M.

kpis.description_fr: Prix moyen box corrugated. PPW index US +3 hausses 2024-25. Pricing power restauré post-déstockage 2023.
kpis.description_en: Average corrugated box price. PPW US index +3 hikes 2024-25. Pricing power restored post-2023 destocking.

kpis.description_fr: Marge EBITDA ajustée. Cyclique (OCC scrap input, box pricing). Cible LT 18-20% à synergies pleines.
kpis.description_en: Adj EBITDA margin. Cyclical (OCC scrap input, box pricing). LT target 18-20% at full synergies.

kpis.description_fr: Capacité installée containerboard mondiale post-merger. 60+ mills, Amérique du Nord + Europe + LatAm. #1 mondial.
kpis.description_en: Global installed containerboard capacity post merger. 60+ mills, NA + Europe + LatAm. #1 globally.
